spec.smp: Cake-me's artisanal cheesecakes turn everyday moments into memorable, shareable celebrations of happiness.

emails.purpose: welcome: introduce the brand and its spirit
emails.subject: Hey you, welcome to Cake-me 💛
emails.preheader: Artisanal cheesecakes made to turn ordinary days into little celebrations.
emails.headline: Welcome! We're so happy you're here 🌟
body_blocks: Hi, friend! We're Cake-me, and we make artisanal cheesecakes.
But honestly? We're not just a dessert shop. We create happiness. Every cheesecake is made to turn an everyday moment into something memorable and shareable.
You're part of the Cake-me crew now, so we'll share our favorite discoveries with you. Want to take a peek around while you're here? 🩷
claims: Cake-me sells artisanal cheesecakes
Cake-me's cheesecakes turn everyday moments into memorable, shareable celebrations of happiness

emails.purpose: value: help readers explore the cheesecakes on the site
emails.subject: Ready to find your cheesecake? 🌟
emails.preheader: See what's on our site and find the one that fits your next moment.
emails.headline: Let's find your perfect cheesecake
body_blocks: Here's the fun part: picking! Our cheesecakes are artisanal, and each one is made for sharing.
So think about your next moment. A cozy night in? A get-together with your favorite people? A Tuesday that needs a little sparkle? There's a cheesecake for it.
Hop over to our site and see the whole lineup for yourself. We can't wait to hear which one catches your eye! 💛
claims: Cake-me's cheesecakes are artisanal
Cake-me's cheesecakes are made for sharing
The cheesecake lineup can be browsed on thecake-me.com

emails.purpose: convert: invite readers to browse and choose
emails.subject: Your next little celebration 🩷
emails.preheader: Birthday, Tuesday, or just because: pick a cheesecake to share with your people.
emails.headline: Make your next moment a celebration
body_blocks: You don't need a big occasion to celebrate. Sometimes a really good cheesecake and the right people is all it takes.
That's what we're all about at Cake-me: turning everyday moments into happy, memorable ones.
So go on, treat yourself! Browse our artisanal cheesecakes and pick the one that makes you smile. We're cheering you on 🌟
